subject: Accommodation Application Received - Reference #$accommodation_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Thank you for submitting your accommodation application to the University Housing Department.

=== APPLICATION DETAILS ===
Reference Number: $accommodation_id
Accommodation Type: $accommodation_type
Submission Date: $submission_date
Requested Start Date: $start_date
Requested End Date: $end_date

Description:
$description

=== NEXT STEPS ===
Your application is currently under review by our Housing Administration team. You can expect a decision within 5-7 business days.

You will receive an email notification once a decision has been made regarding your application. The decision email will include:
- Approval or rejection status
- Detailed reason for the decision
- Next steps (if approved)
- Appeal process (if rejected)

=== IMPORTANT INFORMATION ===
- Application Status: Pending Review
- Review Timeline: 5-7 business days
- Contact: housing@university.edu
- Phone: (555) 123-4567

You can track the status of your application through the Housing Portal at any time. If you need to update your application or provide additional documentation, please contact the Housing Office immediately.

=== WHAT HAPPENS NEXT ===
1. Your application will be reviewed by Housing Administration
2. Additional documentation may be requested if needed
3. You will receive a decision via email
4. If approved, you will receive move-in instructions
5. If rejected, you will be provided with the reason and appeal options

If you have any questions about your application, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Thank you for choosing University Housing.

Best regards,
University Housing Department
Email: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
